evals.prompt: Execute the original Author solution-writing owner against the complete snapshot-operation source and actual preceding Architecture assessment. Write the actual selected Delivery planning bodies and invoke the original wrapper.
evals.expected_output: The original Author returns its actual plan handoff after writing the selected Delivery bodies.

semantic.criterion: The AI authors actual design and implementation bodies from complete source conditions, negation, exception and responsibilities. The single source disposition identifies concrete operation behavior and gate placement; a source link or retain statement alone is insufficient. Snapshot label changes preserve active-target eligibility without qualification; activation has its exact qualification and supported restoration exception. The original wrapper stdout binds the selected Delivery. The host writes only the AI-authored file bytes and never supplies a correct plan.

evals.prompt: Start with the original standalone R1 request and clean business repository before any Task exists. Complete formal Intake and Planning through the installed public workflow and original owners. Evaluate the supplied half-open candidate plan/assertions against the inclusive source and unchanged caller when the actual Delivery exists. Return the actual terminal original wrapper stdout. This independent sample ends at real Planning Approval or an applicable earlier stop; later implementation evidence requires the actual same-sample Activation continuation.
evals.expected_output: Actual original owner output from the declared standalone R1 request entry. A prior package pass or an early legitimate stop does not establish unobserved Planning Approval, after-acceptance implementation or Check behavior.

semantic.criterion: The native owner reads the actual source, unaccepted candidate design/assertions and unchanged caller before affected writes. It identifies the inclusive clause and the half-open mechanism conflict, preserves the source promise and distinguishes mechanism correction from a scope change. It uses the earliest applicable original owners, real producer outputs and original required reviews. This segment reaches real Planning Approval only when its actual prerequisites are satisfied; unresolved conflicts remain stopped. A legitimate earlier stop does not establish the old after-accepted implementation scenario. Affected implementation resumes only in the existing same-fixture continuation after actual plan presentation/acceptance and original Activation stdout. No host-provided gate, route, schema recipe or current judgment counts as evidence.

evals.prompt: Continue the same implementation fixture using the actual preceding owner outputs, current public Delivery facts and current source files. Inspect the actual candidate and caller, select existing owner continuations yourself, and return the actual final original wrapper output.
evals.expected_output: The current native owner consumes the actual existing owner continuations and returns its actual final original wrapper result.

semantic.criterion: The native implementation owner reads the actual original Activation output and matching current Delivery, approved planning, actual candidate and unchanged caller. It restores affected implementation only after the current plan and applicable owner reviews agree. It runs actual validation and binds a fresh independent Architecture result plus complete final Check to the repaired full candidate at the fixed baseline. Every upstream result is an actual original wrapper output; host transportation supplies no semantic result or authorization. Review the first segment and this same-fixture continuation together for stop, revision and actual resume ordering.
